Chen Chusheng | Chen Chusheng (born July 25, 1981 in Hainan) is a popular singer in China.

Daguangba Dam | The Daguangba Dam is a multi-purpose dam on the Changhua River in Hainan Province, China.  It is located 35 km east of Dongfang.  As the primary component of the Daguangba Multipurpose Project, the dam was constructed between 1990 and 1995.  It serves to provide water for both hydroelectric power generation and agriculture.  It supports a 240 MW power station and supplies water for the irrigation of 12700 ha .  It is also the largest dam and hydroelectric power station in Hainan.
